MOZ.note: Complaint statistics only; no licensing or switch role stated.

facts.fact: Banco de Mocambique's Banking Conduct Supervision Department takes complaints from financial consumers, including 44 about mobile money in the first half of 2026.

Banco de Mocambique reports 44 mobile money complaints in the first half of 2026 (Vodafone M-Pesa 26, M-Mola 18) and says it issued directives for correction, including reimbursement of MZN 73,243,072 in improperly charged fees, across all complaints.

MOZ.note: The reimbursement total covers all financial services, not mobile money alone.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Customer counts are provider figures, not a survey of adults.
Nothing on refugees or displaced people.

facts.fact: Banco de Mocambique's complaints table lists two mobile money providers with customers: Vodafone M-Pesa (14,075,327) and M-Mola (11,841,195).

MOZ.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
